_doc: The opening's backdrop: one opaque 16:9 Codex image per piece, resized to 640x360 by tools/art/opening_build.py. refs are extra style anchors after art_source/sprites_tiles_d.png.
style: Modern pixel art with a dynamic-lighting look for a 2D side-scrolling game: chunky visible pixels, rich shading with soft highlights, bright saturated lively colours, hand-made feel like the attached reference sheet but lighter and more colourful. Crisp pixel edges, no anti-aliased blur, no text, no watermark, no border or frame.
opaque: The image fills the whole frame edge to edge.

backdrop.prompt: A wide 16:9 landscape (1792x1008) painted-pixel backdrop for a turn-based battle scene: a quiet, sunny late-afternoon residential street in Japan seen from the side, hopeful and inviting. A flat asphalt road across the lower third with a worn white crosswalk, a pavement and low kerb behind it, a vending machine, utility poles with sagging cables, a low stone wall with blossoming cherry trees, tile-roofed houses and a soft hazy blue sky with warm golden light and fluffy clouds. Bright, saturated, friendly colours: peach, mint, sky blue, soft gold. Keep the road area empty and uncluttered where characters will stand. No characters, no vehicles, no text and no signs with letters.
